newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea KDK in 4-for-10 rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Korea KDK in 4-for-10 rights offer.

text.p: Korea KDK Co Ltd said on Friday it planned to offer a four-for-10 rights issue in May to raise operating funds.

A company statement said Korea KDK would issue 1.06 milion new common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to its shareholders as of April 17 for rights.
Subscription was set for May 15 and 16, with payment due by May 29.
The rights issue will be made at a 25 percent discount to a base issue price to be announced at a later date.
With the rights issue offer, paid-in capital in the company will rise to 15.92 billion won from 10.61 billion at present.
Korea KDK's shares closed at 11,900 won on Friday, down 1,000. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
